units: <cite ref="Yoma 12a:6">Yoma 12ᵃ</cite> it is usage to leave in the inn <he>ג׳ ומשכא</he> the (empty) wine pitcher and the hide (of the slaughtered animal).

<cite ref="Nedarim 49b:11">Ned. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>שקיל ג׳ וכ׳</he> would carry a pitcher (on which to sit during the lectures) on his shoulder.—Pl. <he>גּוּלְפַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="C00726"><he>גּוּלְפֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 71a:8">B. Bath. 71ᵃ</cite> the house <he>דמחזיק מאה ג׳</he> which has room for one hundred jugs (placed in rows).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 32a:2">Ab. Zar. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>בג׳ חיורי</he> in unglazed jugs.

<cite ref="Chagigah 25b:16">Ḥag. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>למיטרח אג׳</he> to provide jugs (for the harvest). [<he>גולפין</he>, <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 9:5">Targ. Esth. IX, 5</cite>, a clerical tautography of <he>גולמין</he>, v. <cite ref="C00399"><he>גּוֹלְמָא</he></cite>.]
